methodologyNotes: Covers standalone floor-mounted residential toilets sold as a complete fixture (bowl plus tank where applicable) at a published US MSRP or typical retail price. Excludes standalone bidet seats and washlets (see bidet-toilet-seats), wall-hung carrier/in-wall tank systems, portable/RV/composting units, and commercial flushometer fixtures. Price is typical US retail or MSRP in USD for the complete toilet. flushType is an enum: gravity, pressure-assisted, or dual-flush. flushVolumeGpf is the full-flush water use in US gallons per flush; for dual-flush models this is the higher (solid) volume. mapScore is the MaP (Maximum Performance) test result in grams of solid waste cleared in a single flush, higher is better; null if the model has not been MaP-tested. bowlShape is an enum: elongated or round-front. bowlHeightInches is the floor-to-bowl-rim height in inches excluding the seat (comfort/chair height is roughly 16.5 to 19). roughInInches is the drain rough-in distance in inches (standard is 12; some models offer 10 or 14). trapwayDiameterInches is the fully glazed trapway inner diameter in inches; null if not disclosed. pieceCount is an enum: one-piece or two-piece. waterSenseCertified is a boolean (EPA WaterSense certified, effective flush at or below 1.28 gpf). seatIncluded is a boolean (toilet seat included in the box). weightPounds is product weight in pounds.
